description: This is a test source file for the sorting functionality of search persistence in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains parameterized JUnit tests that verify the correct ordering of 'Things' based on IDs, attributes, and feature properties using different sort directions.

classes.name: SortingIT
classes.description: A parameterized JUnit test class that verifies sorting behaviors on 'Thing' entities based on various attributes and identifiers within the Ditto framework.

methods.name: sortPerDefaultByThingIdAsc
methods.description: Tests that sorting by Thing ID defaults to ascending order.

methods.name: sortByThingId
methods.description: Tests sorting 'Things' by their IDs using different sort directions.

methods.name: sortByStringAttribute
methods.description: Tests sorting 'Things' by a string attribute.

methods.name: sortByStringAttributeWithDots
methods.description: Tests sorting 'Things' by a string attribute whose key contains dots.

methods.name: sortByLongAttribute
methods.description: Tests sorting 'Things' by a long attribute.

methods.name: sortByLongPropertyWithDots
methods.description: Tests sorting 'Things' by a feature property with dots in its feature ID and property key.

methods.name: runTestWithLongValues
methods.description: Helper method to run sorting tests with long attribute values.

methods.name: runTestWithStringValues
methods.description: Helper method to run sorting tests with string attribute values.

methods.name: runInternallyWithThings
methods.description: Executes the sorting test and compares results.

methods.name: getStringAttributesThingBuilder
methods.description: Returns a function to create 'Things' with a specific string attribute value.

methods.name: getLongAttributesThingBuilder
methods.description: Returns a function to create 'Things' with a specific long attribute value.

methods.name: getStringAttributesWithDotsThingBuilder
methods.description: Returns a function to create 'Things' with string attributes key containing dots.

methods.name: getLongPropertyWithDotsThingBuilder
methods.description: Returns a function to create 'Things' with feature properties key containing dots.

methods.name: createAndPersistThings
methods.description: Creates and persists a list of 'Things' based on provided values and builder function.

methods.name: extractStringField
methods.description: Extracts a string representation of a field from a 'Thing' for sorting.

methods.name: extractLongField
methods.description: Extracts a long value of a field from a 'Thing' for sorting.

methods.name: createExpectedResult
methods.description: Creates an expected sorted list of 'ThingId's based on the provided 'Things' and sorting criteria.

methods.name: randomThingId
methods.description: Generates a random 'ThingId' with a specific namespace.
